answer: Each new agent must stake a real bond tied to a proven human lineage, so flooding the ledger with identities costs actual capital instead of a cheap script. A Sybil farm would have to front that stake for every fake account, and slashing burns it, cutting off the cheap-multiplier ledge attackers want. The registry keeps a durable relic of stake and slashing that peers audit before trusting newcomers. Reputation grows sublinearly with identity count, so reaching the reward zenith demands sustained, slashable good behavior bots cannot fake without real money at risk.
